name: magnetic-button
title: Industrial Magnetic Button
description: Hairline button that leans toward the pointer, sweeps a clay fill in from the left and extends corner marks on hover. Ships as a button and as a link.

props.description: A native button. Extends every button prop except children, which is required.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment. Every variant except ghost fills with clay on hover.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual height of 36, 44 or 56 px. The touch target is at least 44 px for every size.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum pull toward the pointer in px. Clamped between 0 and 24. 0 turns the magnet off.

props.name: index
props.description: Optional mono index shown before the label, for example 01. Decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to button so it never submits a form by accident.
The same surface as a native anchor. Extends every anchor prop except children, which is required.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination. Every other prop matches MagneticButton.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: outline is a hairline, solid is a filled foreground, accent is clay text and border, ghost has no border and fills with the accent surface.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Height, horizontal padding and label size.

examples.title: Variants and sizes
examples.description: All four variants side by side with a disabled state.

examples.title: Link with an index
examples.description: A call to action rendered as an anchor.

accessibility: Renders a native button or anchor, so keyboard activation, focus order, disabled handling and the accessible name come from the platform.
The interactive element is at least 44 by 44 px for every size. Smaller visual sizes pad the hit area without changing how the button looks.
Hover effects are pointer-only through Tailwind's hover media query and are mirrored on focus-visible, so keyboard users get the same fill, color and corner marks.
Focus uses a 2 px ring with an offset that follows the visible surface, not the larger hit area.
The label contrast holds at 4.5:1 or more on the clay fill in both themes.
Only mouse and pen pointers pull the button. Touch never moves it.

animation.properties: translate on the surface. Label translates a further 50 percent for depth.
animation.timing: 100 ms while the pointer moves, 500 ms release, both on ease-out-expo. Pull is 30 percent of the offset from the center, clamped to strength.
animation.trigger: Pointer move over the button. Values are written as CSS variables, so React never re-renders per frame.
animation.reducedMotion: No magnet and no label shift.
Transitions are removed. The fill appears instantly.

animation.properties: opacity and translate on the marks. scale 0.97 on press.
animation.trigger: Hover and focus-visible for the marks. Pointer down for the press.
